summary: Extension 7 — Team Permission Layer: All 31 backend tests and all frontend checks PASSED. RBAC for admin role fully functional. Admin sees all cases/commissions/notes unrestricted. Adviser gets 403 on team/members endpoint and on cases not assigned to them. Sidebar shows 'Administrator' label correctly. No broker dropdown shown for admin (no team_id set). Migration script present and correctly structured.

minor.issue: create_commission checks case ownership via assigned_broker_id: user['id'] — admin cannot create commissions for cases owned by other brokers. Extension 7 spec only mentions list visibility, so may be intentional.
update/delete filter by user_id — admin cannot update or delete commissions created by other users. Same caveat as above.
Still filters by user_id for all roles including admin. Only the main list endpoint was updated to use query={} for admins. Inconsistent but may be by design (reminders are personal).

critical_code_review_comments: reminders endpoint still filters by user_id even for admin — if spec requires admins to see ALL commission reminders, this needs a fix (similar to how list_commissions was updated).
clawback-risk endpoint similarly still filters by user_id — admin will only see their own clawback items.

create_commission/update_commission/delete_commission all still scope by user_id — admin cannot CRUD commissions created by other users. Only list is unrestricted. Spec only mentions list visibility so may be correct.
Migration script is idempotent, async, handles None/missing/empty assigned_broker_id correctly — well implemented.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 temp adviser user (TEST_adviser_<timestamp>@brokeros.com) for 403 test, and 1 temp case (then deleted) for admin CRUD test. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Extension 7 fully tested and passing. Key verified items: (1) admin role sees ALL cases (no filter), (2) get_case_filter returns {} for admin/principal, (3) _check_adviser_access blocks advisers on GET/PUT/DELETE cases/{id}, (4) GET /api/auth/team/members returns 200 + {success:true, data:[]} for admin with no team_id, and 403 for adviser, (5) correct URL /api/auth/team/members (not /api/auth/auth/...), (6) Sidebar shows 'Administrator'/'Principal'/'Adviser' labels correctly, (7) broker dropdown hidden when teamMembers.length=0, (8) migration script at /app/scripts/migrate_assign_cases.py is idempotent and correct. Minor: commissions reminders/clawback/create/update/delete still scope by user_id — may need attention if spec requires full admin override.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — No bugs found in Extension 7 implementation. All RBAC rules work as specified.
